body:
**What changed**
- **Keep a version:** a mod's details have **Check this mod for updates**. Turned off, the box says **Not tracked**, the update check leaves the mod out, and the **UPDATE** mark ignores it. An update of the mod keeps the choice.
- **The check button works again after its wait:** in 1.7.0 and 1.7.1 it could stay grey for good after 30 seconds.
- **Ready on the first visit:** only a press on the button starts its 30 second wait, not the check at start.
- **A sign on every click:** the button spins in green while a check runs, at least a second.

**Install:** unzip `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_1.7.2.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
